title: The contract lint flags a repository path an article names as this repo's that HEAD does not hold
goal: kb-verify's lint.py warns when a kb article names a _tools/ path as this repository's and the file is absent at HEAD, so a research fact cannot cite a deleted tool unnoticed

run:
import os, sys, subprocess, tempfile
d = tempfile.mkdtemp(); r = os.path.join(d, "zz"); os.makedirs(os.path.join(r, "dom"))
def w(p, t):
    open(os.path.join(r, p), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(t)
w("_root.md", "---
root: zz
id_prefix: ZZ
visibility: internal
description: planted
---

# zz
")
w("_sources.csv", "id,url,title,publisher,licence,reuse,retrieved_utc,version_or_date,artifact_sha256,used_in,superseded_by
ZZ-aaaaaaaa,https://example.com/a,A,Example,CC,summary,2026-10-16,,,,
")
HEAD = "---
topic: dom/a
priority: P3
applies_to: [x]
retrieved_utc: 2026-10-16
sources: [ZZ-aaaaaaaa]
status: complete
---

# A

## Summary
S.

## Facts
"
TAIL = "
## Reference
R.

## Examples
E.
"

w("dom/a.md", HEAD + "- This repository runs the load through `_tools/zz_deleted_tool.py`. [DER ZZ-aaaaaaaa: planted]
- This repository reads ids with `_tools/kbcommon.py`. [DER ZZ-aaaaaaaa: planted]
" + TAIL)

env = dict(os.environ, KB_ROOTS=r)
b = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/build_index.py", "--root", "zz"], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
assert b.returncode == 0, b.stderr
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, ".claude/skills/kb-verify/lint.py", "zz/dom/a"], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
print(p.stdout.strip())

warns = [l for l in p.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith("WARN")]
ok = any("zz_deleted_tool.py" in l for l in warns) and not any("kbcommon.py" in l for l in warns)
print("lint warns of the missing repo path only:", ok)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
